questions.question_text: The managed cloud hosting service should provision users automatically from Microsoft Entra ID.
The managed cloud hosting service shall support retention rules that can be set by record type.
The managed cloud hosting service should provide a mobile application for iOS and Android.
The managed cloud hosting service should allow business users to configure workflow steps without vendor assistance.
The managed cloud hosting service shall support role-based access control with at least five configurable roles.
The managed cloud hosting service shall support single sign-on with the identity provider used by the Government.
The managed cloud hosting service shall allow authorized users to export any report to Excel and PDF.
The managed cloud hosting service shall support full-text search across all records the user is permitted to see.
The managed cloud hosting service should support electronic signatures that are legally binding in Alberta.
The managed cloud hosting service shall enforce multi-factor authentication for all administrative users.
The managed cloud hosting service shall take a daily backup that can be restored to any point within the previous 14 days.
The managed cloud hosting service shall allow documents of up to 100 MB to be attached to a record.
The managed cloud hosting service shall send an email notification when a workflow step is assigned to a user.
The managed cloud hosting service shall mask personal information in non-production environments.
The managed cloud hosting service shall provide bulk import of records from CSV files, listing validation errors by row.
The managed cloud hosting service shall validate Canadian postal codes and street addresses.
The Proponent shall describe its approach to social procurement, including Indigenous, local and diversity-owned subcontracting.
The Proponent must disclose any actual or potential conflict of interest relating to this RFP.
The Proponent shall provide a profile of its organization, including years in business, number of employees and head office location.
The Proponent must describe the landing zone design, including network segmentation and identity controls.
The Proponent must provide monthly cost reports by application and department (Yes/No).
The Proponent shall describe backup retention options and the process for restoring a single database.
The most recent audited financial statements of the Proponent are to be attached.
The Proponent shall attach a current Workers' Compensation Board clearance letter.
The Proponent must state every assumption and exclusion that affects the prices quoted.
The Proponent shall complete the Pricing Schedule in Appendix C. All prices must be in Canadian dollars and exclude GST.
questions.constraints: Appendix C; Canadian dollars, excluding GST
